cohort: The cohort consisted of 610 women who gave birth at North Shoa Zone Hospitals, Amhara Region, Ethiopia.
finding: The magnitude of meconium-stained amniotic fluid was 30.3%, with a normal hematocrit level being a preventive factor, while MUAC < 22.9 cm, obstructed and prolonged labour, premature rupture of membrane, and fetal tachycardia and bradycardia were significantly associated factors.
